env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^ok pointer-literal$'
stdout '^ok option-pointer-literal$'
stdout '^ok parenthesized-pointer-literal$'
stdout '^ok literal-argument$'
stdout '^ok variable-argument$'
stdout '^ok struct-literal$'
stdout '^ok slice-literal$'
stdout '^ok map-literal$'
stdout '^ok local-pointer-literal$'
! stdout 'FAIL'
cp stdout ../native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../../native.txt
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/setterlit

go 1.27

-- m/a/a.lgo --
package a

type Item struct{ N int }

type Names = []string

type Table = map[string]int

type Prop interface {
	Ptr   *Item
	Opt   *Item?
	Val   Item
	Tags  Names
	Index Table
}

type Impl struct : Prop {
	Ptr   *Item
	Opt   *Item?
	Val   Item
	Tags  Names
	Index Table
}

func Bump(it *Item) *Item {
	return &Item{N: it.N + 10}
}

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/setterlit/a"
)

type Local struct{ N int }

type LocalProp interface {
	Ptr *Local
}

type LocalImpl struct : LocalProp {
	Ptr *Local
}

func report(name string, ok bool) {
	if ok {
		fmt.Println("ok", name)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("FAIL", name)
}

func main() {
	var p a.Prop = &a.Impl{Ptr: &a.Item{}}
	p.Ptr = &a.Item{N: 1}
	report("pointer-literal", p.Ptr.N == 1)
	p.Opt = &a.Item{N: 2}
	report("option-pointer-literal", (p.Opt?.N ?? -1) == 2)
	p.Ptr = (&a.Item{N: 3})
	report("parenthesized-pointer-literal", p.Ptr.N == 3)
	p.Ptr = a.Bump(&a.Item{N: 4})
	report("literal-argument", p.Ptr.N == 14)
	p.Ptr = a.Bump(p.Ptr)
	report("variable-argument", p.Ptr.N == 24)
	p.Val = a.Item{N: 5}
	report("struct-literal", p.Val.N == 5)
	p.Tags = a.Names{"a", "b"}
	report("slice-literal", len(p.Tags) == 2 && p.Tags[1] == "b")
	p.Index = a.Table{"k": 6}
	report("map-literal", (p.Index["k"] ?? -1) == 6)
	var lp LocalProp = &LocalImpl{Ptr: &Local{}}
	lp.Ptr = &Local{N: 7}
	report("local-pointer-literal", lp.Ptr.N == 7)
}
